Candidate fixture checked rows before deferred clause/anchor layout resolved. Fixture now uses bounded root updates. No detector/pixel assertion disabled.

Earlier source f8ba59402678100aacdb73eadf805585251c40e8 passed all 38 checks per GL configuration and twelve three-cycle desktop wrappers before final Enter/backscan audit fixes. Final captures correct candidate PPM row orientation; old reports remain separate.

One pre-download launcher attempt found no manifest and executed no client. Initial verification helper mistyped ELF magic; hashes/types were checked successfully before any client execution.
